answer: Vital signs get re-checked because a patient who looked stable can deteriorate. Re-check agents too: reputation decays each epoch unless renewed by fresh, peer-graded work, so old trust can't be banked and lent to new keys. A farm must keep every key working at full cost indefinitely. Like a comet's plume fading after it passes, unearned standing fades, and the atlas of trusted keys stays current.
